_note: WO-996: AUTHORITATIVE RUNTIME curated set (CanonicalJson Resources-first). StreamingAssets is the library superset. Gear v1 armor catalog. defense = fractional incoming-damage reduction (0.04 = 4%). hpBonus = flat HP add. perk = passive descriptor string (gameplay effect wired in a future WO  -  data-only for now). job 'any' = all classes; 'knight'/'ranger'/'mage' = class-locked. PRICING: iron-primary for plate, food-primary for leather/cloth, crystals gate rare+. Tiered common floor -> legendary sink. Version 2: added 15 class-specific sets (5 per class) alongside the 5 universal entries.

armor.name: Wanderer's Cloth
armor.flavor: Travelers wore it coming into Elarion with nothing, and wore it still leaving with less.

armor.name: Tanned Leather
armor.flavor: Cured twice, stitched tight - the armor of people who could not afford to die but could not afford plate.

armor.name: Chainmail Vest
armor.flavor: Each ring closed by an Oathweld hand. A ward that turned a killing blow - power you could carry.

armor.name: Elarion Plate
armor.flavor: Oathweld plate from the Bright Centuries. It did not dull, it did not rust, and it never wearied the wearer.

armor.name: Aegis of Elarion
armor.saga: The reforged Aegis - Borin's steel, Halvard's Oathweld plating, Pell's Heartwood core, Wren's Last Pressing. Worn with a full Aegis weapon, the Oathweld returns a portion of damage taken as a ward on the Heart.

armor.name: Ironward Plate
armor.perk: Reduces incoming melee damage by a small additional amount while standing still.
armor.flavor: Iron plates fitted for a soldier, not a knight - good enough to keep you standing through the first charge.

armor.name: Bastion Plate
armor.perk: Extended stun on Shield Bash when HP is above 75%.
armor.flavor: Heavy rivets, layered shoulderguards - the kind of plate that says you expect to be hit more than once.

armor.name: Vigil Plate
armor.perk: Gain a brief damage reduction buff after landing a charged attack.
armor.flavor: Named for the knights who kept the night watch at the four gates - they wore this and were still standing at dawn.

armor.name: Emberbrand Plate
armor.perk: Charge attacks release an ember burst on impact, dealing bonus fire-adjacent damage.
armor.flavor: Emberhand poured the last of their forge-heat into this plate. The seams still run hot to the touch.

armor.name: Oathplate of Elarion
armor.perk: A portion of damage taken is reflected to attackers. Oathweld runes pulse brighter as the wearer's HP falls.
armor.saga: The plate of the first defenders - dark iron sealed with Oathweld runes that glow gold and orange. It remembers every oath sworn over it. The runes are not decoration; they are the oaths themselves, still binding.

armor.name: Scout's Leather
armor.perk: Slightly increased movement speed when no enemies are within close range.
armor.flavor: The gear of those who range ahead and come back to report - light enough to run, tough enough to matter.

armor.name: Shadowhide Vest
armor.flavor: Cured in dark oils to cut the gleam - what you wear when being seen is the real danger.

armor.name: Heartwood Warden
armor.perk: Increases critical chance on ranged attacks.
armor.flavor: Heartwood-grown leather with living leaf overlays - the forest remembers who wore it and which way they were running.

armor.name: Windstrider Coat
armor.perk: Dodge chance increases briefly after firing Suppressing Volley.
armor.flavor: A long coat of dark treated leather, silver swirls worked into the lining - built by a scout who survived every patrol she was sent on.

armor.name: Leafcloak of Elarion
armor.perk: Aim charges faster. Nature-adjacent damage bonus on all ranged attacks. Glows faintly green near the Heart.
armor.saga: The first scout who came back from the outer paths wore this. It was grown for her by the Tree itself - the leaves are not attached, they are part of the armor. It has never been fully still.

armor.name: Apprentice Robes
armor.perk: Minor increase to mana regeneration rate.
armor.flavor: Issued by the tutors on the first day. Washed twice a year whether it needed it or not.

armor.name: Aetherweave Mantle
armor.flavor: Woven with aether thread - purple-trimmed, rune-edged, the kind of thing a mage wears when they want to be taken seriously.

armor.name: Arcane Sigil Vestments
armor.perk: Increases all spell damage. Runes on the vestments glow brighter with each successive cast.
armor.flavor: The sigils were pressed into the cloth - orange runes that run across every panel. The vest does not look like armor. It looks like a warning.

armor.name: Starwoven Robe
armor.perk: Meteor Strike pulls nearby enemies toward the point of impact.
armor.flavor: Dark as the space between stars, sewn with constellation patterns in silver-blue thread - what you wear when the sky is what you're drawing power from.

armor.name: Aethercloak of Elarion
armor.perk: Reduces all spell mana costs. Chance for spell echo on cast. Trails blue aether light when moving.
armor.saga: The Keeper's robe from the Bright Centuries - deep void-black lined with living aether, constellation patterns that shift as the wearer moves. It was the master's. She wore it into the dark. It came back; she didn't.
